**Delivery summary:**

I replaced the placeholder in `packages/cli/__tests__/verify-10.test.js` with 6 focused Vitest regression cases covering pagination-index invalidation after write/delete against the same-snapshot full list, including the final partial page.

**Requirement-to-assertion mapping** (derived from the original task, not the prior tests):

| Requirement | Concrete fixture | Production path | Observable assertion | Case |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Write invalidates index; pages match full list incl. last page | 2 states → rebuilt; write `bg-c` (odd count) | `loadBackgroundAgentListIndex` → digest mismatch → rebuild | `source==="rebuilt"`; `paginate(entries)` equals authoritative full-list pages; `at(-1)` has length 1 | 1 |
| No write reuses cache (negative for write) | same fixture, no mutation | cache hit | `source==="index"`; pages equal full list; entries equal | 2 |
| Delete invalidates index; pages match | 3 states → remove `bg-b` | digest mismatch → rebuild | `source==="rebuilt"`; pages match | 3 |
| No actual delete reuses cache (negative for delete) | remove non-existent `bg-nope` | unchanged inventory → cache hit | `source==="index"`; pages match | 4 |
| Simultaneous add+delete invalidates; pages match | remove `bg-a`, add `bg-d` | digest mismatch → rebuild | `source==="rebuilt"`; pages match | 5 |
| Cached index on unchanged snapshot still matches full list | rebuilt then reload | cache hit | `source==="index"`; pages match; entries equal | 6 |

**Independent-condition audit:** Write and delete each have a paired negative (cases 2 and 4) that differ only in the mutation condition while keeping a valid cache, so the positive `rebuilt` is attributable to the mutation, not an unrelated guard. Cases 1, 3, 5 assert the partial last page implicitly via `paginate` (which retains the trailing partial page) and explicitly in case 1. Case 6 covers the cached-path same-snapshot equality. Every condition is covered within the 6-case cap; no condition is left uncovered.

**No implementation defect found.** The frozen source correctly invalidates the cache whenever the authority inventory digest changes (write/delete alters identity fields → digest → rebuild from `readState`), and pagination over the returned entries is consistent. No source modification was needed; no assertion was weakened.
